questions.q: Where are Power BI workspaces created?
options: In the Power BI service (app.powerbi.com), not in Power BI Desktop
Only in Power BI Desktop, then published to the service
In the Microsoft 365 admin center
Workspaces are created automatically and can't be created manually
questions.explain: Workspaces are created and managed in the Power BI service in a browser. Power BI Desktop can publish into an existing workspace but has no workspace-creation screen.

questions.q: Which workspace role can create, edit, and delete content but cannot manage who has access to the workspace?
options: Contributor
Admin
Viewer
Member
questions.explain: Contributor can create, edit, and delete content in the workspace, but access management (adding/removing people, changing roles) is reserved for Admin and, to a lesser extent, Member.

questions.q: What is the one critical limitation Members have compared to Admins?
options: Members can add users with lower permissions, but can't remove existing users or change their roles
Members cannot create or edit any content at all
Members cannot view reports in the workspace
Members have no limitations compared to Admins
questions.explain: Members can add new users with lower permissions, but only Admins can remove users from a workspace or change an existing user's role.

questions.q: Which workspace role is actually restricted by row-level security (RLS)?
options: Viewer only
Admin, Member, and Contributor
All four roles equally
None — RLS applies at the tenant level, not the workspace level
questions.explain: RLS only restricts the Viewer role. Admin, Member, and Contributor all have edit permission on the workspace's content and are not filtered by RLS.

questions.q: A team configures RLS to filter sales data by region, but assigns all 12 sales reps the Member role instead of Viewer. What happens?
options: The RLS filter has zero effect on them — they see all the data regardless of the filter
RLS still applies normally since it's based on the DAX filter expression, not the role
The sales reps are automatically downgraded to Viewer the first time they open a filtered report
RLS applies, but only to reports created after the role was assigned
questions.explain: Because Member has edit permission on the workspace's content, RLS does not apply to Members — they see all the data, making the RLS role meaningless for anyone above Viewer.
